title: The diff here is large due to it being a backport of a full release.  You may need to review from the commandline.
description:
The diff here is large due to it being a backport of a full release.  You may need to review from the commandline.

Fortunately, this is a straight backport; all our changes are included in debian or upstream, so patches were dropped, and this should be effectively equivalent to a sync.  I've attempted to backport the new release onto the respective -update branches to preserve git and changelog history.

There are a couple bugs I'm tracking, namely LP: #1999945, which is merely cosmetic, and LP: #2039206, which affects only mantic since it's an issue with a change in the "util-linux-extra" package which isn't present in lunar or jammy.

I've filled in the SRU/MRE text on the bug; it's pretty boilerplate at this point but I freshened up the wording compared with previous MREs (e.g. LP: #1975767 and LP: #1868012)

There are no autopkgtests for this package.

Bug:  LP: #2028420
PPA:  https://launchpad.net/~bryce/+archive/ubuntu/open-vm-tools-mre-lp2028420
